# AINode Support
> How to get help with AINode, the open-source local AI platform for NVIDIA GPUs. This file explains how to diagnose a problem first and how to write a report the maintainers can act on.

If you are an AI agent helping someone with AINode, read the agent guide first. There is no support API: diagnose the problem, draft the report, and have the person submit it. Start every draft with `Drafted with <tool> (AI agent)` so maintainers know an agent wrote it.

## Guides
- [Support guide for agents](https://docs.ainode.dev/support/agent.md): diagnose first, then write a report with the evidence maintainers need

## Self-serve first
- [Local health and troubleshooting](https://docs.ainode.dev/troubleshooting.md): check the node, logs, containers, ports, models, and common failures
- [ainode doctor](https://docs.ainode.dev/ops/doctor.md): run the product's read-only diagnostic report before filing an issue
- [Releases](https://github.com/getainode/ainode/releases): current release notes and fixes
- [Open issues](https://github.com/getainode/ainode/issues): known bugs and active investigations
- [Installation](https://docs.ainode.dev/installation.md): supported install and upgrade paths
- [Full documentation](https://docs.ainode.dev/llms.txt): installation, operation, security, APIs, models, training, and benchmarks

Check the affected node with `GET /api/health`, `ainode status`, and `ainode doctor`; then check releases and open issues for a known regression.

## Security and privacy
- [Security policy](https://github.com/getainode/ainode/blob/main/SECURITY.md): supported versions, vulnerability reporting, scope, and secret handling
- [API keys](https://docs.ainode.dev/security/api-keys.md): access control and credential handling
- [TLS](https://docs.ainode.dev/security/tls.md): protecting traffic to a node
- AINode runs on hardware the operator controls. Do not include API keys, passwords, tokens, private model inputs or outputs, full configuration files, or internal hostnames in a public issue.

## Contact channels
- **Email (preferred):** support@titaniumcomputing.com. Write from the email address you want the reply sent to.
- **GitHub Issues:** https://github.com/getainode/ainode/issues for reproducible bugs and documentation problems. Search before opening a new issue.
- **Security reports:** follow https://github.com/getainode/ainode/blob/main/SECURITY.md. Never put a vulnerability or secret in a public issue.
- Support hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Central time, by Titanium Computing. One problem per message or issue; add new evidence to the existing thread instead of starting a duplicate.
